entities.summary: Louis Sigismond Isaac Halphen was a French medieval specialist and the author of many important books over a long career. He was noteworthy as the editor of a modern edition of the famous classic Einhard's "Vie de Charlemagne", He was also known as being one of the general editors of the monumental series Peuples et civilisations.
